desc: Formalize the reduction: answer = max over choosing 2K cakes and labeling each with x/y/z such that each label is used an even number of times, of sum of labeled coordinate values (pairing within a label is sum-invariant).

Design the selection/parity algorithm: top-2K by m_i = max(X,Y,Z) as base, then fix label parities (0 or 2 odd labels) via min-cost flips/swaps, including 2-op chains through the third label and 3-op (a,b)×3 patterns with distinct items.
Implement main solution with parity-fix via flip/swap ops grouped by toggle-pair, plus brute-force matcher and stress harness.
Run the stress test; mismatches resolved by enforcing distinct items in multi-op combos and including all ≤3-op net-toggle patterns (costs non-negative ⇒ >3 ops never beneficial).
Produce final optimized code: top-8 unselected pools per label for swap ops (O(N log N) per test), verify samples (12; 209, 333), confirm 64-bit/fast I/O.
Final review: hand-verified both samples against the algorithm, sanity-checked top-8 pool sufficiency and edge cases (K=N/2 empty pool, all-equal values, N=2), confirmed the code block is final.
